scope: Finite descriptive export inspection only; no scientific replay or causal comparison.

max.capped_scope: Per-field 20,000-character export cap; not proof that every field was fully read.
max.elapsed_scope: Includes integration and transport; not model compute, discovery time or serial tool time.

dots.record_scope: Rendered final response only, supplemented by producer PROCESS_RECORD and original scientific assets.

inference: The exports support action, artifact and claim-scope review. They do not identify cognitive strategies, token costs, or causal benefit from autonomy, fresh instances or subagents.
